description: Context-only hooks for the punch report workflow; neither can block a tool call. Each is a single PowerShell invocation: the fleet is Windows-only and Cowork executes hooks on the Windows host under PowerShell, never inside the Linux sandbox, even when the VM is running. Tool matchers name Bash, PowerShell, and mcp__workspace__bash (Cowork's shell tool) explicitly. Each hook has its own EPLUS_NO_* escape hatch. There is deliberately no SessionStart hook (a PowerShell spawn on every session open for every seat). PostToolUseFailure is deliberately NOT wired here: the error-reporting plugin owns that event. The PreToolUse PDF guard was removed in 0.6.4: the working file is still the .docx, but PDFs for self-review and the on-request convenience PDF (scripts/export_pdf.py) are allowed, so there is nothing left for it to deny. Hook form: shell: powershell with a direct & script call, so the app's own PowerShell runs the script in one process (540 ms measured) instead of launching a second powershell.exe (907 ms).
